title: Do NOT use this CTA in your Meta Ads
description: Do NOT use this CTA in your Meta Ads
transcript: Here's why you shouldn't use an engagement based CTA in your meta ads. Yes, it's good to have as many likes, comments, and shares on your ads as possible, but if you specifically ask for that, that's a waste because in your meta ads you can only normally make one call to action, and you absolutely want to be that for something that is more valuable for your business. Like becoming a lead? Like actually buying your product or service. You also don't want to get too crazy in terms of your campaign set up to try and get as much engagement as possible. Don't run an engagement campaign first to try and get more social proof on your ads. Run a conversion campaign and you will get social proof as a secondary benefit. It shouldn't be the primary focus.
